title: Break a table and watch the checker catch it
tagline: Edit a decision table. The checker that guards the build reads it as you type.
intro: A gap is a combination of answers that no rule covers. A conflict is a combination that two rules answer differently. Remove a rule below, or change the JSON, and see what the checker finds. If the table passes, the app runs from it. If not, the table fails the check and the build would stop on it. Nothing you type leaves this page, and nothing is saved.
noscript: This page needs JavaScript to check a table. It makes no network requests and stores nothing.

app.heading: The app
app.noBuildText: npm run build stops on a table with structural errors, gaps or conflicts, so no app would be written from it. This page checks the table only, not the rest of the build.

footer.text: This page checks the text you type with the same engine as the build. It saves nothing and sends nothing.
